title: Outlook freezes on 'Trying to connect'
description: When I opened it today, the 'Trying to connect' message keeps showing for 20 minutes. No mail comes in, and I can't send anything.

worklogs.description: The OST file under %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook was found to be corrupted and was renamed.
Cached Mode was restarted — the mail has progressed to 1.2 GB and is still going.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The OST is being rebuilt; the mailbox is ~4 GB, estimated to take about 1 hour.
